output.brief:
The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Build 7.4.0 crashes at about 2% whether or not the flag is on. That was already true on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramp. 7.3.2 stays at about 0.7%. Within 7.4.0, the flag-on group (2.10%) and the random flag-off holdout (1.98%) differ by only 0.12 points, and that difference is within noise. The flag is only available on 7.4.0, so the raw comparison mixed build with flag. Device memory and usage are the same across the groups. The leading crash cluster, at 41% of events, is a native crash in the upgraded Pixelda image library, which first appeared on 2 Sep. It has no canvas frames. The sync-service deployment doesn't explain it, because 7.3.2 stayed flat after 9 Sep. The SDK change isn't a counting artifact either, since the app-store console's separate count agrees.

Don't go ahead with the plan. Turning off the flag would not fix the crashes, and releasing 7.4.0 to 100% would spread them. Hold the rollout at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash. Keep the existing holdout running to settle whether the flag adds a small effect of a few tenths of a point, which can't yet be ruled out. Confidence is fairly high on the build and library cause, and lower on the flag's own small effect.
